name: dep-check
description: Looks up each package Claude installs (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, poetry): version, license, downloads, age. Stops lookalikes of popular names, barely used and brand new packages until you /deps allow them.

minWeekly.title: Fewest weekly downloads
minWeekly.description: A package downloaded fewer times than this in the last week is stopped until you allow it
